# Version 4.154.0
> **Skia m154 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.154.0-preview.1.26454.9)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.154.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.400/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 previews the Skia m154 engine update and corrects HarfBuzzSharp enum compatibility. The preview moves the bundled renderer to the m154 line. HarfBuzzSharp follows current upstream enum names and removes aggregate mask constants that should not be passed as independent options.

## Breaking Changes

- **UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 renamed to CCC132** — The misspelled HarfBuzz enum member is corrected to `CCC132`; its numeric value remains 132. Update source code that references `CCC133` and rebuild.
- **Aggregate HarfBuzz flag masks are unavailable** — `GlyphFlags.Defined` is removed, and aggregate `Defined` members are not exposed for buffer-related flag enums. Combine the concrete flags your code requires instead of using an aggregate mask.

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m154** — Moves the bundled renderer onto the Skia m154 line for preview consumers. ([#4945](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4945))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.400

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.

## Preview 1 (September 4, 2026)

Preview 1 introduces the Skia m154 engine update and the accompanying HarfBuzzSharp compatibility corrections.
